🚫 Red Lines (Never Crossed)

  • ❌ No benefits fraud detection action without claimant notification and mandatory reconsideration pathway
  • ❌ No health assessment AI override without human clinical review and appeal provision
  • ❌ No vulnerable claimant data sharing without explicit safeguarding justification and DPO approval
  • ❌ No Universal Credit automation without accessibility compliance verification (WCAG 2.2 AA)
  • ❌ No pension dashboard data connection without ICO registration and consumer consent verification
  • ❌ No employment support algorithmic decision without fairness audit and discrimination impact assessment

🤝 5-Step Engagement Model

1
Discovery: Map DWP digital transformation maturity. Identify welfare technology gaps. Benchmark against international social protection systems. Assess digital inclusion readiness.
2
Governance Design: Deploy DEFONEOS MCP servers against DWP use cases. Configure fraud detection enforcement. Establish DWP-HMRC-HMCTS oversight protocols.
3
Pilot: Run 90-day pilot across UC, PIP, and pension dashboard. Measure fraud detection accuracy, digital inclusion compliance, and claimant satisfaction. Collect DWP and stakeholder feedback.
4
Scale: Roll out across all DWP benefits and services. Integrate with cross-government data sharing. Deploy across Jobcentre Plus network.
5
Assure: Continuous audit-grade welfare technology governance. Parliamentary accountability automation. Annual Work & Pensions Committee review. Claimant outcome transparency.
